definitions.explanation: The color silver, or anything that shines with a silvery white color.

definitions.gloss: snow-covered landscape; silvery world of snow
definitions.explanation: A poetic and literary term for a landscape covered in white snow, evoking the image of a silver world.

examples.japanese: {白銀|はくぎん}に{輝|かがや}く{月|つき}。
{白銀|はくぎん}の{髪|かみ}を{持|も}つ{老人|ろうじん}。
examples.english: An elderly person with silver hair.

examples.japanese: アクセサリーが{白銀|はくぎん}の{光|ひかり}を{放|はな}っていた。
examples.english: The accessory was giving off a silvery glow.

examples.japanese: {白銀|はくぎん}の{世界|せかい}が{広|ひろ}がっていた。
examples.english: A silvery world of snow spread out before us.

examples.japanese: {山|やま}が{白銀|はくぎん}に{覆|おお}われていた。
examples.english: The mountains were blanketed in silver.

examples.japanese: {一夜|いちや}にして{町|まち}が{白銀|はくぎん}の{世界|せかい}に{変|か}わった。
examples.english: Overnight, the town transformed into a silvery white world.

notes:
A literary and poetic word that evokes beauty and brilliance. Often used in descriptive writing, poetry, and winter-themed content.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白銀|はくぎん}の{世界|せかい}: silver/snowy world
- {白銀|はくぎん}に{輝|かがや}く: to shine silvery white
- {白銀|はくぎん}に{覆|おお}われる: to be covered in silver/snow
- {白銀|はくぎん}の{光|ひかり}: silvery light

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {銀色|ぎんいろ}: silver color — everyday, neutral
- シルバー: silver — loanword, used for objects and colors
- {銀|ぎん}: silver (the metal)
- {銀白色|ぎんはくしょく}: silver-white — technical/scientific

REGISTER:
More literary and evocative than {銀色|ぎんいろ}. Commonly used in travel writing, literature, and poetic descriptions of winter landscapes.
